purpose: Transparent Eugene cutout matching the user's leaning, spread-arm, crossed-leg dance model; plain sweater with no emblem.
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / pose transfer. Create ONE standalone transparent cutout of Eugene in the EXACT NEW DANCE POSE shown by the white 3D model in reference image 1. Image 1 is authoritative for pose, limb placement, body proportions, silhouette and camera angle. Image 2, the colored Eugene cutout with a plain sweater, is ONLY the reference for colors, clothes, original simple head design and gentle disco lighting. Do not reuse image 2's lifted-leg or hand-behind-head pose.

MATCH THE NEW POSE CLOSELY: a dramatic sideways/backward LEAN with BOTH ARMS SPREAD WIDE and legs crossing in a sliding disco step. From the viewer's perspective, the long neck and head are toward upper-left/upper-middle, the hips sit lower and to the RIGHT of the shoulders, and the body forms a long diagonal lean. The arm toward the LEFT edge stretches outward and diagonally DOWN from the shoulder, elbow slightly bent, with the hand hanging loosely downward near hip height. The arm toward the RIGHT edge reaches outward roughly at shoulder height, elbow slightly bent, ending in a floppy downward wrist and relaxed fingers. Both arms make a broad asymmetrical wing-like silhouette: no pointing, no hand behind the head, no arm across the chest. Both knees bend. The nearer leg sweeps diagonally across in front and extends toward LOWER-RIGHT, its foot planted in the direction seen in the model. The other leg bends and tucks behind it, with the rear foot partially visible near the crossing ankles. Preserve the model's playful off-balance sliding rhythm and foreshortening, rather than a symmetric X pose or generic upright dancer. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Preserve human-like joint anatomy and the model's long thin limbs. Show the entire body and every extremity with clear margins.

HEAD: follow the model's upright long neck and slightly three-quarter head orientation, long lavender-ended muzzle projecting mildly toward picture-right while the face remains partly turned toward the viewer. ONE slender pastel pearlescent horn and two simple ears. Maintain Eugene's ORIGINAL low-poly head: long angular pink wedge, broad plain flat face planes, long horizontal horse muzzle, pale lavender nose block with tiny nostrils, no round baby cheeks or short cute snout. His tiny bead eye may be squeezed into a SMALL SIMPLE black curved squint to convey delighted dancing, as in the colored reference; no whites, big eyes, eyelashes, eyebrows or human facial features. A modest happy open mouth, not a huge grin or oversized teeth. Short rigid blocky rainbow mane with horizontal bands of mint, pale yellow, pink and lavender. No flowing mane or redesign.

ORIGINAL ADULT LANKY BUILD: narrow sloping shoulders, long slim ordinary torso, thin long arms, long thin thighs and shins, modest pink human hands and SMALL low-profile pink shoes with thin pale soles. No muscles, barrel chest, enlarged head, thick thighs, inflated hands or big chunky sneakers. Match the white model's geometry closely; avoid chibi proportions. Keep the deliberate simplicity and slight awkwardness of the original character.

CLOTHES: a PLAIN PALE ICY-AQUA TURTLENECK sweater, sage-mint folded high collar/cuffs, butter-yellow trousers with modest cuffs, and simple pink shoes. The user removed the chest emblem: the sweater has NO unicorn graphic, NO logo, NO lettering or decoration. Keep the sweater unmarked. Retain only restrained warm golden rim light and cyan/magenta disco reflections on the character's actual surfaces. Rich clean low-poly faceted illustration matching the approved colored cutout, with simple original-model geometry.

OUTPUT: genuine transparent RGBA PNG, portrait 1024 x 1536. Fit the broad spread-arm pose centered at a useful large scale with clear space beyond both hands, horn and feet; do not crop an arm to preserve an overly large scale. No floor, tiles, grid, ground plane, cast shadow, reflections, disco room, crowd, spotlight, mirror ball, glow halo, opaque backdrop, screenshot UI, border, text or watermark. Every empty space including between limbs is alpha-zero transparency. No black/white matte or printed checkerboard. One complete character-only layer, faithful to the NEW leaning, spread-arm, crossed-leg white-model pose.
